gold: Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS)

selector.rationale: The presence of localized linear hair loss, hair thinning, and dermoscopic findings of short vellus hairs, yellow dots, and honeycomb hyperpigmentation without broken hairs are more characteristic of Lichen Planopilaris. Although Morphea is supported by the asymptomatic, arc-shaped, depressed skin groove and histopathologic findings of lobular panniculitis and hyaline fat necrosis, the overall evidence slightly favors Lichen Planopilaris due to its specific hair and scalp findings.

rejected.label: Morphea
rejected.why: While Morphea is a close consideration due to the skin groove and specific histopathologic findings, the presence of localized linear hair loss and specific dermoscopic features tips the balance in favor of Lichen Planopilaris.
